scheme_name: Goa Value Added Tax-Based Subsidy on H.S.D. Oil Consumed by Fishing Vessels Scheme
other_conditions: Must have a fishing vessel registered under the Merchant Shipping Act.
Must hold a valid Net Licence and Fishing Licence for the year.
Must not be a defaulter of the Department of Fisheries.
Must not be a violator of the Goa, Daman and Diu Marine Fishing Regulation Act, 1980 and related rules.
Must procure H.S.D. Oil from a Diesel Outlet run by the Registered Fisheries Co-operative Society or from government‑approved outlets.
benefits_summary: Owner receives a subsidy equal to the VAT paid on H.S.D. oil consumed, with a total industry quota of 20,000 KL per financial year.
